what: Planned rule tells implementers to run make py-lint after editing tests
scenario_or_breakage: agents/codex-implementer.md and agents/cursor-implementer.md forbid external implementers from running scripts/relevant-checks.sh or any larch skill; orchestrator-owned validation runs later.
